title: CAM-152 live-validation ceremony: run a story GREEN in the cam-worker container under firewall (operator)
description: Operator ceremony to validate the CAM-152 container-flip end to end (opt-in worker_isolation=container is shipped but unexercised). Prereq: 0.55.0 binary rebuilt+installed. Steps: set [loop] worker_isolation=container in project.toml, ensure the persistent cam-worker container is up, run one representative story to GREEN inside the container under the firewall, confirm claude auth works inside the container, and capture evidence. Ties CAM-116. Hard precondition for trusting CAM-139 (autonomous meta-loop requires container active).
